title: Pomegranate, Apple & Walnut Salad
description: Great8Friends: I love my Bon Appétit magazines, and this has been adapted from Bon Appétit, January 2012. This would be a beautiful addition to your Valentine's Day or Thanksgiving or Christmas dinner.
ingredients: 2 large heads of butter lettuce, cored, washed and torn into pieces
1 ½ cups glazed walnuts, the easy way is to buy them already glazed! (or make some yourself ahead of time)
1 cup pomegranate seeds (done ahead of time)
1 Honeycrisp or Fuji apple, in thin quartered slices
1 recipe Honey Shallot Vinaigrette, see below
¼ cup loosely packed tarragon leaves (very optional)
2 ounces crumbled blue cheese (or goat cheese or feta), about ½ cup
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, if desired
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
directions: In a small bowl whisk together the vinegar, honey, shallot and mustard.
While whisking, gradually add the oil and whisk until well combined.
Season to taste with the salt and pepper.
Place the torn lettuce leaves in a large bowl.
Core and cut the apples into bite sized chunks.
Add the walnuts, pomegranate seeds, and apples to the lettuce.
Start with adding half of the dressing and toss to coat, add more dressing as needed to fully coat the salad.

Add the (very optional) tarragon leaves and cheese, toss until the ingredients are well distributed. (You may want to leave the cheese off the salad and pass it in a small bowl if I am serving guests who may not like blue cheese.)
